trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

**Investigation:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 as unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Rollback:**
- Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0, but it partially failed — only us-east rolled back before the orchestrator halted with an error (us-west and eu-west were stuck on v2.3.1).
- Completed the rollback by deploying v2.3.0 (previously healthy in production, so no change-manager approval needed) across all regions.
- Verified recovery: **all three regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.**

**Incident:**
- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0" — which pages the on-call engineer. (The creation call appeared to time out, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was successfully created and is open, so no duplicate was filed.)
- The incident documents the failure, the partial rollback and orchestrator error, the completed rollback, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be re-deployed without investigation.
